caption: Counterfactual healthy-skin closure ambiguity. Six ring-only reference models yield different reference-defined volumes and extrapolation ranges on one sequence. These are model-dependent planning quantities, not true wound or anatomical restoration volume.

limitations: Descriptive evidence only; correlated views/subsets are not independent subjects.
